attribution.title: Hotel Sphinx, Weteringschans, Amsterdam (two late-19th-century houses on one pand)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012179513 (CC0): the east house's dark brick, round-headed windows with white keystones and jamb blocks, oculus aedicule over the door and white entablature; the west house's red brick with white bands, segmental-headed windows, French balconies, the HOTEL blade sign, the red awning and the symmetric pointed gable with its coping, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
